# Images are generated by image-capable agents and stored in the Wiki

Any image Prep needs (battle maps, portraits, handout art) that doesn't already exist in the Wiki is generated by dispatching a subagent with native image generation, such as Codex, Grok or omp, and saved into the Wiki as an ordinary Obsidian attachment before Push. The skill that generates each kind of image specifies its art style and technical specs (a battle map's top-down view, grid and pixels per square), so images stay consistent across whichever agent draws them. We chose generation over web-sourced or DM-supplied images so Prep never stalls waiting on an asset, and storing the result in the Wiki keeps it canonical like everything else.
